comment: Read by markdown-link-check via checklist-markdown. That tool does NOT
auto-discover this file; the checklist passes --config explicitly, but
only when the file exists, so deleting it restores the unconfigured
default rather than breaking the hook.
This file is for links no CI can resolve, not for links that are merely
comment_aliveStatusCodes: gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports source-tree links, one per bundled
package. Every one of them resolves with a plain `curl` (200, or 307 to
the same page) when checked slowly, one at a time. markdown-link-check
fires all of them in quick succession and gitlab.alpinelinux.org answers a
chunk of that burst with 418 (a rate-limit / anti-bot response, not a real
dead link), and which links get hit depends on request timing, so the
failing set is not even stable between runs.
Accepting 418 here rather than ignorePatterns-ing the whole host: every
link is still actually requested and would still fail on a real 404, a
typo'd path, or a renamed aports directory. Only the rate-limit response
itself is treated as passing, so a genuinely broken link keeps getting
